4. A serious fire ("Fire") broke out in Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po on 26 November 2025, at seven blocks, resulting in 79 injuries and 168 confirmed deaths. On 27 November 2025, Ms WONG Wai-chi, Superintendent (Administration and Support) of Crime New Territories North Regional Headquarters, designated me as the Officer-in-Charge of Kwong Fuk Community Hall ("KF Hall"). KF Hall was assigned as a temporary photo-identification centre for fire fatalities. KF Hall opened at 1500 hrs on the same day, approximately 24 hours after the outbreak of the Fire, to expedite the identification process. KF Hall provided a secure, dignified and controlled environment where photographs of the deceased could be shown to relatives and friends for preliminary visual identification.

5. Each recovered body's images were photographed at the on-site temporary mortuary, whenever a body was sent there, by designated officers from Regional Crime Unit ("RCU") 2A, Regional Anti-triad Unit ("RATU"), Regional Technology and Financial Crime Unit ("RTFCU") from Crime New Territories North Regional Headquarters or Organized Crime and Triad Bureau ("OCTB"). The photographs were subsequently organised into two parallel albums sorted by gender and prepared by designated officers from RCU 2A, RCU 2B, RCU 3A, RCU 3C, RTFCU or OCTB. For those bodies that were severely burnt, only found locations were included in a list without displaying any photo. This dual classification allowed searchers to narrow their focus when visual features were unrecognisable.

6. When a viewer made a positive visual identification, the attending officer would record the assertion on a standard registration form and obtained the viewer's signature. Designated officers from RTFCU or OCTB then arranged appointments with the relatives or friends of the deceased for confirmatory viewing at Fu Shan Mortuary later on. When family members arrived at Fu Shan Mortuary for identification, the pathologist would interview them and compare distinguishing features and medical history provided by the family members.
